consent.title: Find a moisturiser that suits you
consent.intro: WellMatch is a student prototype. Answer five short questions (two are optional) and it shows a short list of products from a small fictional catalog.
consent.p1: All products are invented for this study. Nothing can be bought.
consent.p2: Your answers stay only in this browser tab and are erased when you reload, close the tab or start again. Nothing is sent or saved. At the end you can download your own session file for the study.
consent.p3: Results come from fixed rules. Budget, texture and fragrance decide which products can appear; use time and pack size only change the order. No person or AI is involved.
consent.p4: This is not medical or skin advice.
consent.test: Test session: clicks, errors and timings are recorded anonymously in this tab only. The facilitator may download them at the end.
consent.check: I have read this and want to continue
scope.title: What WellMatch is not
scope.body: WellMatch gives no medical or skin advice.
scope.body2: Choosing “Fragrance-free” is a preference filter, not an allergy check. Always read the full ingredient list, and ask a pharmacist or doctor if you have a skin condition or allergy.
scope.body3: All products, prices and limitations are fictional. WellMatch is not a real shop or a global brand.
q.title: Five quick questions
q.budget.hint: Whole number, for example 6000 or 6 000. Maximum 1 000 000.
q.fragrance.note: Only “Fragrance-free” removes scented products. It is a preference, not an allergy check.
q.soft.title: Optional preferences
q.soft.note: These two never remove a product. They only change the order.
